caption:
Worn out trying to help everyone everywhere? Love starts nearest. (1 Timothy 5:3–8 devotional)

Real care isn't charity handed down; it's honor that lifts a person up. And love that lasts begins in the nearest place and flows by a wise order, not just feeling. You can't carry everyone — start with the one closest.
